title: When a clause evaluates to negative one
statement: Let $C$ be a term on the sign cube of dimension $n$, and let $x$ be an assignment. The clause formed from $C$ evaluates to $-1$ at $x$ if and only if some literal in $C$ has its required sign at its indexed coordinate of $x$.
